build_ocean_for_host: build the Ocean library for the host platform using CMake with default debug and release static configs
build_ocean_for_target: build the Ocean library for a specific target platform like ios_arm64 or macos_arm64 using the CLI
build_ocean_quest: build the Ocean library for Meta Quest using Android ARM64 with Quest extensions enabled
build_ocean_minimal: build the Ocean library in minimal mode with only base, cv, and math modules compiled
build_ocean_dry_run: show the Ocean build plan and target list without actually running any CMake configure or build steps
